outcome: Composite adverse neonatal outcome (5 min Apgar < 7, neonatal intubation, grade 3 or 4 intraventricular hemorrhage, confirmed neonatal sepsis, or NICU admission)
Individual components of the composite outcome
cohort: 374 women with a first-trimester baseline BMI ≥ 40 kg/m2 delivering at a tertiary care institution between July 2013 and December 2017
finding: In women with class III obesity, exceeding gestational weight gain recommendations was associated with increased odds of a neonatal intensive care unit stay longer than 7 days.
